THE CONSTRUCTION

Follow the ocean-side mark.

  1. Upload or paste a map showing the white second-zone circle. Detection is an estimate; adjust the center and radius if necessary.
  2. Choose the nearest ocean direction. A diameter passes through the zone center in that direction.
  3. Two perpendicular marks sit equally around the center, each one quarter of the zone radius away.
  4. The red circle is centered on the ocean-side mark. Its edge passes through the inland mark, giving it a radius of half the white zone radius.

Click “Pick ocean on map,” then click toward the coast. All image processing stays in your browser. Export includes the red prediction; toggle Guides to include or hide the construction.
